correctness_confidence.basis: The mean of the 30 specified June irradiations is 920.02/224.95, while removing the low day gives 4.095. The May inequality uses the largest quotient and smallest mean ratio consistent with rounding.

rigor.basis: The construction preserves positivity, fixes the group multiplicities, uses population moments and treats excluded rounding endpoints by a limiting argument.

novelty.basis: The matched eight-month records and the numerical sharp bound are specific to the published table. The covariance identity and general aggregation issue are classical.

significance.basis: The audit specifies which daily records a plant operator needs before attributing a discrepancy. It does not estimate the magnitude of soiling at this plant.

reproducibility.basis: The nominal capacity, both June mechanisms and the May construction appear explicitly. The PDF would be easier to verify on its own with a permanent link to the reconstruction scripts and full eight-row data.

summary: Both mechanisms yield the same four rounded monthly outputs on this data set. The May yield-weighted ratio is lower than any unweighted daily mean compatible with the printed ratio, under that interpretation of the column. Both pages, including the displayed constructions, are legible. My assessment shares the manuscript-production context.
strengths: Distinguishes a mismatch in means from evidence about a particular sensor.
Derives a sharp variability requirement and gives an attaining family with 31 dates.
weaknesses: The PDF lists the interval check for two months. Readers must reconstruct the remaining six rows from the original article or obtain the accompanying package.
A stable identifier for the code package in the PDF would improve reuse.
potential_errors: Alternative definitions of the performance-ratio column or a different reference plane would change the plant-level interpretation. The text states those dependencies.
strong_novelty_candidates: The joint daily witnesses that preserve all eight published monthly records and the sharp May bound are candidates for case-specific contributions. Broader originality is unestablished.
